checks.name: frame
checks.detail: CRC-8/ATM check value 0xF4 over "123456789"; a transposition changes the checksum; encode/decode round-trip with type+payload intact; the wire checksum is recomputed independently over type+payload and matches; a corrupted checksum is rejected; a start byte inside the payload does not split the frame; an undersized buffer and an over-long payload are both refused; noise before a frame is ignored and the next frame still decodes; an impossible length is rejected

checks.name: civil
checks.detail: the epoch is day zero and seconds_from_epoch at midnight is 0; 2000-03-01 is day 11017 and 2026-11-03 is day 20760; the time of day is included in the seconds; February has 28 days in 2026, 29 in 2024 and 1900 has 28 while 2000 has 29; March has 31 days and April 30; the inverse from_days round-trips for 20760, 0 and 11017; the weekday is 4 (Thursday) at the epoch and 2 (Tuesday) on 2026-11-03

checks.name: bcd
checks.detail: 8-bit BCD known values 0/9/10/99; decode 0x42 to 42; a nibble above nine is refused; 16-bit BCD 1234 and decode 0x5678; an invalid 16-bit nibble is refused; the RTC year is a full year (0x26 BCD and 0x1A binary both decode to 2026, 0x1A read as BCD is refused as -1); encode produces the register spelling (0x26 BCD, 26 binary); a year outside the register's century is refused rather than truncated

checks.name: mask
checks.detail: requiring every field skips nothing and requiring none skips everything; the inversion is per field; every representable mask round-trips through skip and back; a mask asking for a field the backend cannot compare is refused
